name: m-up holdings, Inc.
summary: m-up holdings, Inc. engages in the development and distribution of mobile and PC content, and e-commerce businesses in Japan. It operates through two segments, Contents Business and the Electronic Ticketing Business. The Contents segment provides paid content for smartphones and PCs, distributes smartphone applications, and sells artist merchandise and packaged goods such as CDs through the internet to users of mobile devices. The Electronic Ticket segment offers electronic tickets and official ticket trading services for music live performances and concerts, sporting events, as well as various related services; sells artist merchandise and music through fan club sites.
